conventions.name: init-files-are-barrels
conventions.description: Package __init__.py files should only define the package public API through docstrings, imports, __all__, and re-export aliases.

conventions.name: absolute-imports-only
conventions.description: Non-barrel Python modules should use absolute imports instead of relative imports.

conventions.name: no-underscore-exports
conventions.description: Modules should not list underscore-prefixed names in __all__.

conventions.name: class-name-matches-filename
conventions.description: A *_service.py module should export a PascalCase Service class matching the file stem.

conventions.name: exported-constants-are-upper-case
conventions.description: A constant module should export an uppercase constant derived from the file name.

conventions.name: docstrings-on-public-api
conventions.description: Public classes and functions should have docstrings.

conventions.name: annotated-public-functions
conventions.description: Public functions and methods should annotate parameters and return values.

conventions.name: paired-test-files
conventions.description: Top-level source modules should have matching tests/test_<module>.py files.
